name: EMS Solutions

Our workers are dedicated ensuring our company values of providing superior quality, delivery, customer service, and competitive pricing for customers seeking to manufacture their electronics in the United States, are met with each contract we fulfill. about:
EMS Solutions operates from Ogden, Utah, along the Wasatch Front near Salt Lake City. The company was founded in 2000 as a contract manufacturer with limited capabilities and now operates as a division of PCB Solutions Inc. Over two decades it has grown into a regional full-service electronic manufacturing services provider.

The facility runs four SMT lines backed by automated optical inspection and automated through-hole placement equipment, supported by solder paste inspection. Core services span printed circuit board assembly, cable and harness assembly, box build, new product introduction, and full turnkey manufacturing that includes procurement, assembly, and test. The company also offers supply chain management, design collaboration, and expedited manufacturing services, handling volumes from prototype through high-volume production.

Customers come from RF and wireless, medical, industrial, aerospace, military, and consumer product sectors. The company cites experience with leaders in each of these fields, providing both prototype and production-run support for a variety of electronic assemblies.

EMS Solutions emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing as a differentiator, noting that domestic production eliminates international shipping costs, shortens lead times, and subjects operations to stricter regulatory standards that yield safer, higher-quality products. The company states its values center on superior quality, on-time delivery, customer service, and competitive pricing, with in-house IPC training and 100% AOI, SPI, and functional testing built into every order.
